remedies.title: Chandra / Shiva mantra for moon
remedies.practice: Om Shram Shrim Shraum Sah Chandraya Namah - 11000 repetitions over 40 days.
remedies.rationale: Mantra japa is the safest first remedy: it pacifies moon without amplifying it.

remedies.title: Charity (daan) for moon
remedies.practice: Donate rice, milk, or white cloth on a Monday.
remedies.rationale: Daan discharges the karmic debt of an afflicted moon rather than strengthening it.

remedies.title: Monday observance
remedies.practice: Light fasting or a simplified sattvic diet on Mondays.
remedies.rationale: The weekday of moon concentrates its remediation.
cautions: Skip fasting entirely if pregnant, diabetic, or medically advised against it.

remedies.title: Pearl (moti) (only after trial)
remedies.practice: Pearl (moti) may support moon as a functional benefic that lacks strength.
remedies.rationale: moon rules a trikona for this lagna and is weak but unafflicted, the one case where a strengthening stone is classically sanctioned.
cautions: Gemstones amplify a planet indiscriminately; wear only after a trial period and only if the planet is a functional benefic for this lagna.
Do not combine with gemstones of inimical planets already being worn.
Advisory only - consult a qualified astrologer before purchase; quality and setting matter more than size.
